name: NoVA Winter Break 2026
information:
Wednesday, December 23rd: 2x2x2 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube
Thursday, December 24th: 6x6x6 Cube and Skewb
Friday, December 25th (Christmas): 5x5x5 Cube and Pyraminx
Saturday, December 26th: 3x3x3 One-Handed and Clock
Sunday, December 27th: 4x4x4 Cube and Square-1

There is a **separate 24-person limit** for each event. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 40 hasn't been reached.
